name: pyside6
title: Qt for Python (PySide6)
description: PySide6 6.12.0 with Qt 6.12.0 itself: every module of the open-source edition (Core, Gui, Widgets, Qml, Quick, Quick Controls, Network, Sql with SQLite, Svg, WebSockets, Charts, Graphs, 3D, Quick 3D, Multimedia, WebEngine, Pdf ...), the platforms offscreen, xcb and wayland, Designer, Linguist, Assistant, lupdate, lrelease, qmllint, qmlformat, qmlls and pyside6-uic, pyside6-rcc. `import PySide6` works in the python3 on PATH (Python <3.16, >=3.10: the toolchain python, attached with it) and in a virtual environment; without a display Qt draws offscreen (QT_QPA_PLATFORM). The license texts and the sources of these binaries: licenses/ and NOTICE.txt in the tree (https://download.qt.io/official_releases/QtForPython/pyside6/PySide6-6.12.0-src/pyside-setup-everywhere-src-6.12.0.tar.xz, https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/6.12/6.12.0/single/qt-everywhere-src-6.12.0.tar.xz).

build.text:
#!/bin/sh
# sandbox-ai-mcp toolchain pyside6: PySide6's own commands (its console scripts pyside6-uic, pyside6-rcc ...),
# run with the python3 on PATH.
tool=$(basename "$0"); tool=${tool#pyside6-}
PYTHONPATH="{prefix}/python${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" exec python3 -c 'import sys
from PySide6.scripts import pyside_tool
name = sys.argv.pop(1)
sys.argv[0] = "pyside6-" + name
sys.exit(getattr(pyside_tool, name.replace("-", "_"))())' "$tool" "$@"

Qt for Python (PySide6, Shiboken6) with Qt 6.12.0, as published by The Qt Company, unchanged.

Licenses: Qt and Qt for Python are available under LGPL-3.0-only, GPL-2.0-only or GPL-3.0-only; some

files.app.py:
import sys
from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer, QUrl, qVersion
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication
from PySide6.QtQuick import QQuickView
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QLabel

app = QApplication(sys.argv)
label = QLabel("hello from PySide6")
label.resize(200, 60)
label.show()
view = QQuickView()
view.setSource(QUrl.fromLocalFile("hello.qml"))
view.show()


def colours(image):
    return {image.pixelColor(x, y).name() for x in range(0, image.width(), 4) for y in range(0, image.height(), 4)}


def done():
    widget, quick = label.grab().toImage(), view.grabWindow()
    widget.save("widget.png")
    quick.save("quick.png")
    print("pyside6", qVersion(), QGuiApplication.platformName(), "widget", len(colours(widget)) > 1, "quick",
          "#2060c0" in colours(quick) and len(colours(quick)) > 1)
    app.quit()


QTimer.singleShot(500, done)
sys.exit(app.exec())

notes: The Qt Company's wheels from PyPI (URL, SHA-256 and upload day from PyPI's JSON API; written by scripts/qt_recipe.py pyside6 VERSION). x86_64 only: the aarch64 wheels need glibc 2.38, sandbox-ai's images have 2.36. The wheels hold no license text: licenses/ is from the release's tag in pyside-setup and qtbase, NOTICE.txt names the sources. Not checked at a start, because not every sandbox needs them (optional): the xcb and Wayland platforms (--gui; the agent images have their libraries), Multimedia (libpulse), WebEngine (Chromium's libraries, in the agent images; as root it wants QTWEBENGINE_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1), the GTK theme, CUPS, the SQL drivers other than SQLite.
